parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The keyword used to perform a fuzzy search by task ID or task name.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of results returned per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
The job status. Valid values:

- Planning: The job is in the Plan execution phase.
- Planned: The job has completed the Plan execution.
- PlannedAndFinished: After the Plan execution is complete, no diff is found. The job is in a final state.
- Applying: The job is in the Apply execution phase.
- Applied: The job has completed the Apply execution.
- Errored: The job execution encountered an error and entered a final state.

sub_parameters.name: tagKey
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the task.

sub_parameters.name: tagValue
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the task.
